dataset_title: Population and dwelling counts: Canada and census subdivisions (municipalities)
geographic_coverage: All Canadian municipalities / census subdivisions, subject to Census notes
formats: CSV (ZIP); SDMX via Web Data Service
temporal_coverage: 2016 and 2021 Census counts; not current population estimates
verification: Official table identifies municipal coverage; ZIP content type observed, contents not unpacked
notes: Filter by GEO / municipality and province; retain DGUID or other geographic identifiers when present. Do not treat municipal boundaries as metropolitan boundaries. This is one shared national resource, not one unique dataset per city.
